content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: continuous-batching -> streaming path p95/p99 spike detected (auto-pager fired). Started ~2025-11-18T12:03:00Z. Affected route: /v1/stream (us-west-2). p95 baseline ~40ms -> 2.3s, p99 peaked ~6.8s. SDK streaming stalls reported. Dash: https://dash.redwood.example/contbatch/streams — paging @lee and @eng-oncall

lee: I'm on it. Seeing paging alerts and some customer retries. Triage plan: 1) confirm impact 2) attempt live mitigation (disable cont-batch for stream routes) 3) adjust scheduler fairness knobs 4) follow-up postmortem.

maya: Quick metric dump: KV cache evictions spiked 4x at the same time, average batch sizes jumped (median tokens per batch 1.9k -> 4.4k), and mix of seq lengths shifted (more long tails). Suspect mixed-seqlen packing + greedy stream packer.

raj: I can flip continuous batching off for the streaming route as a rapid mitigation. Will do a rolling change on a single pod first. Command I use:
```bash
# disable continuous batching for the stream route (prod)
rwdctl routes update --route streaming-gen --set continuous_batching.enabled=false --env prod --rollout 1
```
Expect immediate latency improvement for streaming at cost of lower token throughput.

lee: go ahead, do one pod, canary, then roll if green. Notify @cs-ops before full roll.

eng-runtime-bot: rollout started: id rll-20251118-331. Target pod: runtime-usw2-12. Patch applied, waiting for health check.

eng-runtime-bot: health check passed on pod runtime-usw2-12. Observability: p95 for that pod dropped from 2.1s -> 95ms within 18s (streaming path).

sophie: Nice — can we also tweak pack_window_ms and max_batch_tokens to avoid re-amplification? Proposed: pack_window_ms: 10 -> 6, max_batch_tokens: 8192 -> 4096 for streaming. That limits extreme pack growth on long sequences.

maya: +1. Also recommend enabling per-queue seqlen weight (fairness) so long requests don't monopolize pack slots.

raj: Rolling rest of pods with continuous batching disabled for stream route. Rolling now.

eng-runtime-bot: rollout completed across 12 pods (streaming route cont-batch disabled). Aggregate p95 now ~120ms, p99 ~350ms for /v1/stream (down from 2.3s / 6.8s). Throughput delta: -18% tokens/sec for streaming routes.

lee: Live mitigation succeeded. Immediate customer impact: 3 enterprise customers observed timeouts (retries) during peak — total ~1.2k failed stream sessions in the 7 minutes window. No data loss, just increased latency/timeouts. @cs-ops can you start customer outreach for those accounts?

cs-ops: On it. Drafting short note: "We experienced elevated streaming latency 12:03-12:10UTC due to batch scheduling anomaly. We've applied a mitigation restoring normal streaming latencies; you may see transient retries. No data loss. We will follow up with root cause and ETA for permanent fix." Will ping legal if needed.

sam: For next steps/longer-term: 1) rework packer heuristics to include seqlen-aware bucketing 2) add emergency kill-switch that only applies to streaming packer rather than whole runtime 3) add telemetry: per-route pack size histogram and seqlen distribution alerts. I'll own the RFC for 1) and 3).

lee: Agreed. Also produce a short-runbook change: when streaming p95 > 500ms and p99 > 2s, consider flipping cont-batch off for streaming routes + lowering max_batch_tokens. Add to oncall runbook.

maya: Data note: KV server side evictions correlate with packer growth; we should consider KV cache reservation for streaming KV entries to reduce paging under load.

raj: For completeness, here is the admin toggle if we need to re-enable quickly:
```bash
# re-enable continuous batching for the stream route (if ready)
rwdctl routes update --route streaming-gen --set continuous_batching.enabled=true --env prod --rollout 1
```
Use with caution — only after packer fixes.

lee: Handing off monitoring/watch to @sam for the next 4 hours. sam, you'll have pager escalation if p99 > 1s again. I will open an incident ticket and postmortem template now.

sam: Ack, taking watch. I'll keep the cont-batch disabled for streams until we ship a safer packer change or autoshedding.

sophie: I'll draft the quick mitigation PR to lower pack_window_ms and max_batch_tokens with performance regression tests.

cs-ops: Customer notif sent to the three affected accounts (sales notified as well). No critical SLA credit required per CS triage; will update if customers escalate.

lee: Closing slack triage. Incident-level: HIGH -> mitigated (live) but investigate RCA. Postmortem owners: sam (runtime changes), maya (kv/metrics), sophie (packer), raj (live toggle doc). Assigning now in incident tracker. :white_check_mark:

(reacted :eyes: by all)
